item.evolvedwarfare.recruitment_contract: Right-click a free recruit in a city,
camp or watchtower to hire them.
gui.evolvedwarfare.button.follow.tip: Follows you everywhere. If left far behind, appears next to you.
gui.evolvedwarfare.button.home.tip: Goes back home and wanders around it.
gui.evolvedwarfare.button.set_home.tip: Makes its current spot its home, and stays there.
message.evolvedwarfare.recruited: %s has joined you. Don't forget to pay them with food!
message.evolvedwarfare.for_hire: %s is looking for work. Hire them with a Recruitment Contract.
message.evolvedwarfare.last_provision: %s was paid with their last provision. Give them more tomorrow.
message.evolvedwarfare.unpaid: %s wasn't paid today. Without pay, they'll leave in %s day(s).
message.evolvedwarfare.deserted: %s left due to lack of pay. Their gear was left on the ground.
message.evolvedwarfare.died: %s has died. Their gear was left on the ground.
item.evolvedwarfare.command_staff.toolti: Right-click: your nearby NPCs follow you.
Click a block: they go and guard it.
Click an enemy: your soldiers attack it.
item.evolvedwarfare.medic_kit.tooltip: Give it to a recruit and train them as a medic.
gui.evolvedwarfare.button.train.tip: Turns them into a soldier based on the weapon in hand: sword = warrior, axe = barbarian, bow = archer, crossbow = crossbowman, medic kit = medic. To give them a trade, use a work post.
message.evolvedwarfare.train_needs_weapo: %s needs a weapon in hand: sword, axe, bow, crossbow or medic kit.
message.evolvedwarfare.staff.guard: NPCs going to guard that spot: %s
message.evolvedwarfare.raid.start: Bandits are attacking! Defend the settlement.
message.evolvedwarfare.raid.victory: You fought off the bandit raid!
block.evolvedwarfare.town_hall.tooltip.0: Pays your NPCs within %s blocks on its own.
block.evolvedwarfare.town_hall.tooltip.1: Store food or coins: tops them up to %s days.
gui.evolvedwarfare.site.help.tool: Their tool goes in their hand; spares go in the supplies.
gui.evolvedwarfare.site.help.storage: Top: supplies. Bottom: output (hoppers pull from below).
gui.evolvedwarfare.button.assign.tip: Puts your nearest recruit (within 24 blocks) to work here.
gui.evolvedwarfare.button.dismiss.tip: Leaves the post: becomes a recruit again and follows you.
gui.evolvedwarfare.button.area.tip: Outlines the work area with particles.
message.evolvedwarfare.site.no_recruit: You have no recruit within %s blocks. Hire one and bring them here.
message.evolvedwarfare.site.dismissed: %s leaves the post and is a recruit again.
message.evolvedwarfare.worker.lost_site: %s has lost their work post and is a recruit again.
profession.evolvedwarfare.farmer.info: Tills soil near water, sows and harvests.
profession.evolvedwarfare.farmer.supplie: Needs: seeds, potatoes or carrots. Extra: bone meal.
profession.evolvedwarfare.lumberjack.inf: Fells whole trees and replants saplings.
profession.evolvedwarfare.miner.info: Digs an entrance with a small barn on top and, underground, a shaft all the way down.
profession.evolvedwarfare.miner.supplies: Needs: a pickaxe. Extra: planks (for the barn) and torches.
profession.evolvedwarfare.digger.info: Digs dirt, sand, gravel and clay out of a pit.
profession.evolvedwarfare.digger.supplie: Needs: nothing. Much faster with a shovel.
profession.evolvedwarfare.fisherman.info: Fishes in nearby water (4+ water blocks).
profession.evolvedwarfare.fisherman.supp: Needs: nothing. Faster with a fishing rod.
profession.evolvedwarfare.shepherd.info: Shears sheep, milks cows and goats, breeds them.
profession.evolvedwarfare.shepherd.suppl: Needs: wheat and buckets. Shears in hand to shear.
profession.evolvedwarfare.breeder.info: Breeds chickens, pigs and rabbits, collects eggs.
profession.evolvedwarfare.breeder.suppli: Needs: seeds, carrots, potatoes or dandelions.
profession.evolvedwarfare.beekeeper.info: Harvests honey from hives and nests, plants flowers.
profession.evolvedwarfare.beekeeper.supp: Needs: glass bottles (or shears for combs). Extra: flowers.
profession.evolvedwarfare.gardener.info: Harvests melons, pumpkins, cane, cactus, bamboo, berries.
profession.evolvedwarfare.gardener.suppl: Needs: nothing. Replants cocoa and nether wart.
profession.evolvedwarfare.blacksmith.inf: Smelts ores and raw metal into ingots.
profession.evolvedwarfare.blacksmith.sup: Needs: ores or raw metal, and fuel.
profession.evolvedwarfare.cook.info: Cooks meat, fish and potatoes; bakes bread.
profession.evolvedwarfare.cook.supplies: Needs: raw food or wheat, and fuel.
profession.evolvedwarfare.stonemason.inf: Carves stone: bricks, polished stone, sandstone.
profession.evolvedwarfare.stonemason.sup: Needs: cobblestone, stone, andesite, sand... Faster with a pickaxe.
profession.evolvedwarfare.fletcher.info: Makes arrows and gets flint from gravel.
profession.evolvedwarfare.fletcher.suppl: Needs: flint, sticks and feathers, or gravel.
status.evolvedwarfare.waiting: Waiting for something to be ready
status.evolvedwarfare.nothing_here: Nothing to do in the area
